steps.text: Bring a shovel and a rope.
West of Kazordoon past the Dwarf Mines: dig the loose stone pile behind the plum tree and go down.
steps.source: Travel west of Kazordoon past the Dwarf Mines and use your shovel to dig a Loose Stone Pile hidden behind a Plum Tree.

steps.text: Walk west (minotaurs) and rope up into the Secret Hideout.
steps.source: Once you go down the hole, walk west and rope up into the Secret Hideout.

steps.text: Minotaur guards and archers: go up the ladder in the north.
steps.source: ground floor: 2 Minotaur Guards, 2 Minotaur Archers

steps.text: Minotaur guards: go up the next ladder.
steps.source: first floor: 4 Minotaur Guards, 4 Minotaur Archers

steps.text: The drawers next to the table: 56 gold.
steps.source: 56 Gold Coins can be found in a Chest of Drawers next to a table

steps.text: The box between the two beds: 47 gold.
steps.source: 47 Gold Coins can be found in a Chest between two beds

steps.text: The box next to the anvil: the steel helmet.
steps.source: Steel Helmet can be found in a Box next an anvil
